name: FlySBS Aviation Limited
tagline: NSE/BSE-listed private-charter aviation operator (single 13-seater Embraer Legacy 600, dry-lease model) with genuinely strong ROE/ROCE and low debt, but a single-aircraft concentration risk and a niche ultra-elite TAM keep the four-box score short of a clear thesis fit.
business_overview: FlySBS Aviation Ltd is a DGCA-approved non-scheduled airline operator providing private, non-scheduled air charter services from India to an elite clientele, operating one 13-seater Embraer Legacy 600 aircraft under a dry-lease model across domestic and long-haul international routes (Far East, Middle East, New Zealand, Arctic Europe, North America, as far as Mauritania). Listed on NSE (FLYSBS) and BSE (95380) via an SME IPO on 8 August 2025 that raised ~Rs 102.5 Cr (fresh issue only), debuting at a 90% listing-day premium. Entity confirmed via NSE/BSE listing matching state.json name 'Flysbs'.
fundamentals_narrative: The numbers are genuinely strong for a recent SME IPO: ROE 26%, ROCE 35%, low leverage (D/E 0.12), and a reasonable implied P/E (~19x) against those returns. The structural caveat is the business model itself - a single aircraft under dry lease is a severe concentration/key-asset risk (any extended maintenance, loss, or lease disruption directly halts revenue), and the addressable market (ultra-elite non-scheduled charter) is inherently small and niche versus a scaled aviation business. Promoter holding at ~32.5% is on the lower side for an SME-platform company, worth watching but not itself a red flag.
